The sentiment trend described in the text indicates a recovery from a negative initial state to a sustained positive outcome. Initially, the launch was characterized as "rocky," implying negative sentiment. However, subsequent analysis revealed a "high and stable positive trend." This shift was driven by specific actions: "consistent quality updates" and "customer engagement," which allowed the company to not only recover but also improve its reputation. The emerging pattern is one of resilience and successful reputation management through proactive improvement and engagement.
